## Discrepancies and how they were resolved

| Id | Field | Resolution |
|---|---|---|
| D1 | Indoor airflow, heating, High | The build brief lists 564 m3/h. Visual inspection of S2 p.6 shows 534 m3/h in the merged MSZ-AP25/35 column; 564 m3/h belongs to the MSZ-AP42 column. S1 lists 148 l/s = 533 m3/h. 534 m3/h is used. |
| D2 | Heating min-max capacity | S1 (2021 sheet): 4.0 (1.6-4.3) kW. S3 p.6 (OBH789-A): 4.0 (1.3-4.6) kW. Both kept; the reference profile uses S1 for the catalogue range and reports S3 as a discrepancy. Nominal 4.0 kW agrees. |
| D3 | Rated compressor frequency | Not stated numerically. Inferred from the S3 p.23 correction curves (factor 1.0) as about 84 Hz cooling and 95 Hz heating (digitised, +/-2 Hz). |
| D4 | Indoor fan power vs fan step | S2 p.6 gives 19 W cooling / 26 W heating "measured under rated operating frequency" without naming the fan step. S3 p.21 says airflow is set at MAX for the performance curves. The 19/26 W ratio matches the Super High rpm ratio cubed (970 vs 1070 rpm), so both are taken at Super High. Inference, flagged as calibrated. |
| D5 | Brochure airflow (other regions) | Some regional retailer listings give 82-223 l/s (cooling). S1 and S2 for the UK E1 variant give 82-190 l/s / 294-684 m3/h. Regional data are not mixed in. |
| D6 | Sensible heat factor at rated cooling | S3 p.29-30 implies SHF 0.88 at 27/19 degC, 3.5 kW and 684 m3/h. With that airflow the leaving air would have to be above saturation (about 102 % RH). The coil model keeps the physics and reports SHF about 0.84; the table SHC column is fitted with a reduced weight. |
